method: Each control copies the three surfaces and both sidecars into a fresh scratch tree, writes a stand-in canon holding only flagship_sidecars.pins, applies one mutation, runs the gate with --dir, and requires the exit code, the exact set of FAIL lines and the resolved paths. C0 runs first.

controls.control: C1 one link dropped from the MAP_GRAPH_DATA sidecar
expected_fails: sidecars/map_graph_data.json data_md5 describes its own data
sidecars/map_graph_data.json is byte for byte what
observed_fails: sidecars/map_graph_data.json data_md5 describes its own data
sidecars/map_graph_data.json is byte for byte what build_map_sidecars.py emits from this flagship

controls.control: C2 one Map 1 weight flipped in the sidecar
expected_fails: sidecars/map1_transitions.json data_md5 describes its own data
sidecars/map1_transitions.json is byte for byte what
observed_fails: sidecars/map1_transitions.json data_md5 describes its own data
sidecars/map1_transitions.json is byte for byte what build_map_sidecars.py emits from this flagship

controls.control: C3 whitespace only: one space before the sidecar's final newline (same JSON)
expected_fails: sidecars/map_graph_data.json is byte for byte what
observed_fails: sidecars/map_graph_data.json is byte for byte what build_map_sidecars.py emits from this flagship

controls.control: C4 one character of a mechanism label changed inside the flagship's MAP_GRAPH_DATA
expected_fails: sidecars/map_graph_data.json is byte for byte what
observed_fails: sidecars/map_graph_data.json is byte for byte what build_map_sidecars.py emits from this flagship

controls.control: C5 one word of Map 1's served caveat changed in the flagship
expected_fails: sidecars/map1_transitions.json is byte for byte what
observed_fails: sidecars/map1_transitions.json is byte for byte what build_map_sidecars.py emits from this flagship

controls.control: C6 one hex digit of the Map 1 canon pin changed
C7 a second canon file beside the first
C8 the MAP_GRAPH_DATA sidecar absent from --dir resolves to the repo's own copy
